import json,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('workspaces/repository-file-inventory-20261109')
s=json.loads((root/'stage2_summary.json').read_text())
p=json.loads((root/'progress.json').read_text())
for repo in p['order']:
    f=root/'repos'/repo/'files.json'
    if f.exists():
        d=json.loads(f.read_text())
        print(repo, 'EXISTS', str(f), 'rows',len(d.get('rows',[])), 'repository',d.get('repository'), 'scope',d.get('scope'))
    else: print(repo,'MISSING',str(f))
print('total',sum(len(json.loads((root/'repos'/name/'files.json').read_text())['rows']) for name in p['order']))
